data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2016 were GBP 308.104m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of approximately GBP 2.95m (c.0.96% of opening reserves), driven by mixed movements across older underwriting years but with the Managing Agent explicitly citing adverse developments in prior year reserves on the Treaty class. The report also highlights significant 2016 natural catastrophe activity (Hurricane Matthew, earthquakes in New Zealand/Taiwan/Japan, Cyclone Winston and Canadian wildfires) impacting the Property portfolio in 2016.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of GBP 6,859k (2015 - deterioration of GBP 29,646k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to adverse developments in prior year reserves on the Treaty class.

losses on the 2015 and 2016 years of account are driven by new catastrophe and large losses in the year, primarily on the Property, Special Lines and Treaty classes, and attritional loss development on the Property and Personal Accident & Sickness lines.
The Property book suffered a number of natural catastrophe claims arising from Hurricane Matthew, earthquakes in New Zealand, Taiwan and Japan, Cyclone Winston and the Canadian Wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding 31 Dec 2015). Prior-year development gross amount was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 33-34). The movement note (note 7) provides a net (after reinsurance) deterioration (GBP 6.859k); no explicit gross prior-year movement figure is printed, so gross PYD was computed from the triangle. Triangle numbers are presented in thousands in the report; the prior_year_development_gbp_m above is the sum of gross changes for underwriting years 2011-2014 converted to millions. No RITC distortion noted. Where only net amounts were stated in narrative, these were captured in exact_reserve_text but not used as the primary gross PYD source.
